name: Seamless.AI
description: Seamless.AI finds decision-makers' emails and phone numbers, enriches lists and feeds the CRM. It also offers intent signals and a LinkedIn extension.
summary_fr: Recherche de contacts commerciaux vérifiés en temps réel.
